messages:
alex: kicking off the scalability rehearsal for eu-central-1 region — goal is to validate soak, autoscaling, and handoff to oncall/qa. plan attached inline.

mira: thanks. short checklist?

alex: high level: 1) GPU pool bootstrap (prewarm images, preload model shards), 2) run 2h soak at 30% of target qps, 3) burst tests to 120% for 10m, 4) autoscaler tuning (scale-out cooldowns, per-pod concurrency), 5) validation run and handoff.

devon: adding networking checks: ensure MTU, egress routes to artifact storage, and cross-AZ latency < 15ms. last launch had issues with jumbo frames.

serena: for GPU warmup we should pre-load weights into NVMe cache on new nodes. script I used: 
```bash
ssh node && sudo systemctl start model-preloader
# copies latest shard snapshot to /var/cache/models && primes mmap
```

li: autoscaler params I propose: min=4, target_cpu=60, target_gpu_util=65, scale_up_window=45s, scale_down_window=5m, max=200. also set per-pod max_concurrency=20 for gtx-4090 pools.

mira: curious on why scale_down_window 5m? last time we oscillated when it's 60s.

li: yes — increasing window reduces flapping during soak. we monitor queue length rather than instant util for decisions.

alex: test plan timings: start soak 14:00 UTC, soak phase 14:00-16:00 (2h). at 14:30 run 10m spike to 120% qps. ramp schedule: 0->30% in 5m, 30->60% in 15m, maintain 30% baseline during soak then spike.

devon: add tolerances: tail latency P99 < 400ms for generation route, error-rate < 0.5%, CPU steal < 1%. if any breached -> abort and roll back routing to us-east-1.

ops-bot: deploy job triggered by alex at 2026-03-18T13:55:00Z. cluster bootstrap started.

qa-bot: preflight checks queued. will run smoke tests once pool reports READY.

serena: also watch KV cache hit rate. if prefix cache miss > 10% for > 15m, we need to increase warmup or adjust caching TTLs.

alex: cost guardrails: cap on spot usage 30% of cluster, and max projected hourly spend for the test = $1,200. alert finance channel if burn projection exceeds 80%.

mira: handing off to oncall after soak: oncall runbook (short): 1) verify node health (kubectl get nodes -l gpu=true), 2) check model-serving pods (kubectl rollout status), 3) run small inference probes hitting canary endpoint, 4) escalate to oncall if replicas < min or p99 > threshold.

li: quick config snippet for HPA policy we used: 
```yaml
apiVersion: autoscaling/v2
kind: HorizontalPodAutoscaler
metadata:
  name: model-hpa
spec:
  minReplicas: 4
  maxReplicas: 200
  metrics:
  - type: Pods
    pods:
      metric:
        name: gpu_utilization
      target:
        type: AverageValue
        averageValue: "65"
```

devon: notes from last rehearsal: kube-proxy conntrack overflow caused 502 spikes — lowered conntrack_hashsize helped. will apply as daemonset config before soak.

alex: OK starting warmup now. mira and devon please own the soak phase and live notes here. li will patch autoscaler if we see oscillation. serena on cache priming. qa-bot drop status once smoke done.

qa-bot: smoke tests passed on control plane, model-serving pods READY=12/12, avg startup 38s.

mira: soak started — baseline 30% qps. first 10m checks good, p99 ~320ms, errors 0.12%.

devon: applying conntrack tuning now. will monitor for any transient 502s during spike.

alex: preparing spike at 14:30 UTC in 5m. li on standby.

li: standing by. scaling cool-down set to 45s.

ops-bot: spike load generator job started.

mira: spike executed. short p99 bump to 540ms for ~90s, autoscaler added 18 pods within 2 minutes, dropped back after spike. no errors.

serena: KV cache hit rate climbed from 72% -> 94% after warmup. good.

devon: observed one 502 cluster-wide at t+3m, root cause conntrack exhaustion on some nodes, fixed by new config. logging incident in postmortems.

alex: soak phase complete. metrics: average p99 350ms, errs 0.18%, spot interruption rate 0.3%. within acceptable band.

mira: handing off to oncall now. oncall runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall-region-warmup

li: I'll open a follow-up ticket to reduce max_concurrency to 16 on smaller instances to improve tail latency.

ops-bot: handoff completed by mira at 2026-03-18T16:05:21Z.

alex: nice work. notes for next run: 1) pre-apply conntrack tuning to cluster infra, 2) bump preloader concurrency by +2 for large models, 3) try aggressive cold-start reuse patch.

mira: I'll write the short runbook update and ping infra-oncall group.

serena: ETA for doc updates today EOD.

alex: closing thread. will link postmortem once drafted. :tada:
